action_items: (Minor) Harden PUT /api/admin/spin/config: reject prizes lacking the 'weight' field (or default it to 1), so restoring the ladder from a snapshot of the public GET endpoint doesn't silently zero-out all odds. The public GET strips weight by design.

(Optional) /pay-with-wallet does not perform an atomic findOneAndUpdate on order.status — same TOCTOU pattern flagged in iter-7's deposit-approve helper; two concurrent pay-with-wallet calls could double-debit. Wrap the read+set in db.orders.find_one_and_update({id,status:{$nin:['verified','paid',...]}}, {$set:{status:'verified',...}}) and only credit if matched.
server.py is now 4705 lines — please split (refunds.py, spin.py, wallet.py) as flagged in iter-7.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_refund_update branch logic at server.py:4416-4440: when body.status=='approved' AND method!='wallet', code sets upd['status']='approved' but never advances to 'completed' — that's by design (manual payout), but timeline only logs one entry. Recommend a second timeline note after admin marks the off-platform payout done.

admin_refund_update sets upd['refund_amount']=float(body.refund_amount) in the trailing block (line 4443-4444) which OVERWRITES the value set inside the 'approved' branch (line 4421). Harmless when body.refund_amount is provided, but if it's None on a re-PATCH, it could blank it out. Use `body.refund_amount is not None` guard (already done) — actually fine, but flag for review.

_handle_refund_tg silently swallows /tg_send failures via outer try in caller — if bot token is missing, tracker query returns nothing to user. Consider returning a 'bot not configured' error log entry.

Pay-with-wallet falls back to service price * qty when payment_amount is missing, but it uses int(order.get('qty') or order.get('size') or 1). 'size' is the order's size field and is a free-form string ('small'/'medium'/...) in the OrderIn model — int() will throw ValueError on non-numeric values and return 500. Guard with try/except or drop size from this fallback.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest: /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_refund_wallet_spin.py — 24 tests, ~20s. Key patterns: (1) /auth/me returns {user:{user_id:...}} (NESTED) not flat — use mj['user']['user_id']. (2) /api/services endpoint does NOT exist — cart items in localStorage are arbitrary client objects, no backend validation. (3) Cart uses localStorage key 'eh_cart_v2' as a JSON array of {type,id,name,price,qty,...}. (4) AuthContext does NOT pick up direct localStorage.setItem('eh_token',...) on mount — must login via /api/auth/login and follow the cookie redirect for full UI auth state; otherwise wallet-pill stays hidden. (5) Forcing a spin winner: PUT /admin/spin/config with a single prize {weight:100} — but ALWAYS restore via DEFAULT_SPIN_PRIZES (with weights) afterwards; restoring via the public GET strips weights and silently zeros odds. (6) For pay-with-wallet integration testing without an admin quote endpoint, hit POST /api/payments/proof first to set order.payment_amount (also sets status to 'payment_review' which is NOT in the 'already paid' guard list — so the subsequent pay-with-wallet call succeeds).
rca_of_the_issue: No backend bug uncovered. Only minor observations: PUT /admin/spin/config trusts the client to send weights, so restoring from public-GET output zeroes odds (highlighted as minor backend issue + action item). The TOCTOU race on pay-with-wallet (read order → debit → set status) is the same pattern flagged in iter-7's deposit-approve, recommended atomic findOneAndUpdate fix carried forward.
